name: Stoke Mountain
description: Stoke Mountain is rewriting the rules of skiing and snowboarding. Where old-school meets the next generation. Stoke Mountain is a family-owned indoor ski and snowboard training center in Tukwila, Washington. Built by skiers and riders, for skiers and riders, we offer year-round progression through professional instruction, alpine ski machines, trampolines, freestyle terrain, and airbag training. From first-timers to seasoned athletes, we're here to keep the stoke alive.
